rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: AI accelerates code volume while review workload, iterations, and bottlenecks intensify.
rationale.quality-debt: Links weak review, missing context, and shallow comments to maintainability debt.
rationale.automation-bias: Analyzes capable developers rubber-stamping authoritative AI outputs despite verification duties.
rationale.ai-review: Coordinates specialized LLM agents to judge PR alignment, defects, impact, and comments.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Sandboxed executions provide reproducible logs, traces, and runtime evidence.
rationale.risk-routing: Risk and centrality scores route PRs into fast or rigorous lanes.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Mandatory author verification and reviewer approval gates retain blocking authority.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Evidence-anchored diff maps, summaries, and explanations support human PR judgment.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Alignment agent detects missing requirements and unrelated scope-tangling changes.
rationale.tooling-supply-chain: Analyzes malicious PR prompt injection compromising review agents and exfiltrating secrets.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent summaries, source anchors, audit logs, and decision traces preserve reviewability.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes fully autonomous review by preserving accountable human merge authority.
